venira.avoid_when: you only want size/mtime without content (get_file_info).
venira.output_kind: single-file: text (as preview in compact mode; preview_truncated marks a cut), first_line, last_line, truncated, next_start_line, total_bytes, sha256 (whole-file, safe as expected_sha256). venira.speed_profile: very fast on repeat; cache validated by mtime+size.
venira.use_when: you need one (or several) file(s)' content. When truncated, call again with start_line=next_start_line. Multi-file: pass requests[]; each item runs exactly like its own read_file call and one failing item does not stop the rest.

description:
Read a text file, whole or by line range, or several files in ONE call (`requests[]`, max 8, each with read_file's own arguments). ranges[] for several disjoint ranges of one file.
Use when: you need one (or several) file(s)' content. When truncated, call again with start_line=next_start_line. Multi-file: pass requests[]; each item runs exactly like its own read_file call and one failing item does not stop the rest.
Avoid when: you only want size/mtime without content (get_file_info).
Output: single-file: text (as preview in compact mode; preview_truncated marks a cut), first_line, last_line, truncated, next_start_line, total_bytes, sha256 (whole-file, safe as expected_sha256). Multi-file (requests[]): data.responses[] each {ok, response|error}, count, total_bytes_returned; one item failing answers status:'partial' with ok:false. Missing path gives not_found.

line_numbers.description: true prefixes each line with its line number (default false).

max_bytes.description: Max bytes returned (default and max 1 MiB).

ranges.description: Multiple disjoint ranges of the SAME file (max 16); use instead of several read_file calls on ONE file.

max_bytes.description: Max text bytes for this range (default: the top-level max_bytes).

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative file to read. Omit when sending requests[] (multi-file call).

requests.description: Multiple files in ONE call: each item takes read_file's own arguments (relative_path required per item, plus start_line/end_line/ranges/max_bytes/line_numbers). Omit for a single-file read using the top-level parameters. Max 8 items; each item behaves exactly like its own read_file call.

relative_path.description: Required (optional here so one bad item fails only itself).

name: read_file
title: Read file
